items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: Diana Watson and Illinois Jackie was playing. You can remember them, they were playing together.

ctx.x: So we did, we went on to that term. And the night we got there, Diana Watson and Illinois Jackie was playing. You can remember them, they were playing together. So after they went off, the show went off, and we came on, I don't know, people just went, they went wild and see that guy, that little boy in the main walking the bar with the guitar playing, and then that little boy would get on his shoulders and play together. So the guy told him, he said, man, you got a four weeks contract right now. So I said, well I…
company, but anyway, he had a record company there.
